thread:
maya (Finance): Heads-up — customer Acme Health escalated. Their AP team says our invoice PDF is missing required legal fields for EU compliance plus PO placement. They specifically asked for: legal entity full name, VAT number, full postal address (separate billing/legal), PO number in the header, and per-line VAT amount. Can we confirm what the current template outputs?

samir (Support): Repro steps from customer: 1) Sign up, 2) Add billing contact and PO in account settings, 3) Download invoice for invoice# 2026-0412. Their PDF only shows company display name and a single tax summary at bottom. They fail internal validation.

lucy (Billing-ops): Confirmed — our current template (v2) uses these placeholders: CompanyDisplayName, BillingAddress, TotalTax. We don't render LegalEntityName or LineItemTax by default. PO is captured in the DB but only printed in footer via 'notes' block. Not compliant for some enterprise buyers.

andrew (Engineering): I can change the PDF generator but need exact field mapping and a sample expected layout. Also need to know whether PO should be mandatory in header for all invoices or only when PO present. Suggest: if PO exists, put PO#: <value> next to invoice number in header.

maya (Finance): Yes — customer requires PO in header. Also need "Legal entity" block between header and billing address. Example: Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. VAT: GB999999999. Billing address: 123 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94103.

samir (Support): Customer also said some invoices are for reseller flow where legal_entity != billing contact. We need to support multientity invoices (seller / reseller / end-customer) or at least allow explicit legal_entity fields on invoice objects.

lucy (Billing-ops): Action: Add fields to invoice payload: legal_entity_name, legal_entity_address, legal_entity_tax_id, and line_items[].tax_amount. We should also decide rounding and currency display rules for per-line VAT.

andrew (Engineering): Prototype mapping I can implement in generator:
```json
{
  "invoice_number": "{{invoice.number}}",
  "po_number": "{{invoice.po}}",
  "legal_entity": "{{customer.legal_name}}",
  "legal_address": "{{customer.legal_address}}",
  "legal_tax_id": "{{customer.vat_id}}",
  "line_items": [
    { "desc": "{{items[0].desc}}", "qty": "{{items[0].qty}}", "unit": "{{items[0].unit_price}}", "tax": "{{items[0].tax_amount}}" }
  ]
}
```
This will require API and DB changes to surface legal fields on invoice export.

maya (Finance): Good start. Also request: add a per-line "tax_rate" column and a summary table that shows Tax breakouts by jurisdiction (e.g., VAT 20% UK, 0% reverse-charge DE). That helps our customers' accounting.

invoicobot: Invoice generated: invoices/2026/2026-0412.pdf (template v2).

samir (Support): Customer posted a sample from their AP validation tool — attached in thread (we can't attach here) but gist: their system expects header-level PO and a separate block: "Legal entity (billing)" with VAT ID next to company reg.

lucy (Billing-ops): Priority: P1 for enterprise customers with active invoices failing AP ingestion. I'll log a billing ticket and mark for next release if engineering agrees.

andrew (Engineering): Estimation: 3 dev days to add fields + 1 day to update PDF templates + 1 day QA (edge cases for multi-entity). Will need API version bump for invoice export endpoint. Also need acceptance criteria: sample PDF that contains legal_entity_name, legal_entity_tax_id, PO in header, and per-line tax amounts for 3 currencies.

maya (Finance): Acceptance criteria noted. Please include sample PDFs for: 1) Single-entity EU VAT customer, 2) Reseller flow (seller + reseller + end-customer), 3) Zero-rated reverse-charge entries. Customer will revalidate on our staging environment once available.

andrew (Engineering): I'll create a branch and upload sample PDFs to "/staging/invoices/preview/1782345678". ping me for review.

lucy (Billing-ops): I'll update billing docs and add migration notes for any existing customers whose invoices might change layout.

samir (Support): I'll coordinate with Acme Health and schedule a validation window next week. :thumbsup:

maya (Finance): Thanks team. Assigning owners: Lucy -> billing spec, Andrew -> implement + PDFs, Samir -> customer validation. Reopen if blockers. :white_check_mark:
